Typed client and contracts for the Shiny.AppDeviceBridge beacons bridge — iBeacon ranging, background region monitoring, Eddystone scanning and broadcasting as a beacon — for a web app hosted by Shiny.AppDeviceBridge. Register with services.AddBeaconsBridgeClient().

Geofencing endpoints for a Shiny.AppDeviceBridge web app, backed by Shiny.Geofencing — permissions, monitored regions, and enter/exit transitions delivered to the page as events and to background.js. One call: bridge.AddGeofenceBridge().

Typed client and contracts for the Shiny.AppDeviceBridge geofencing bridge — monitor circular regions and hear when the device enters or leaves one — for a web app hosted by Shiny.AppDeviceBridge. Register with services.AddGeofencesBridgeClient().

GPS and motion activity endpoints for a Shiny.AppDeviceBridge web app, backed by Shiny.Gps — permissions, current and last position, a listener streamed to the page as events, and walking/running/driving recognition. One call each: bridge.AddGpsBridge(), bridge.AddMotionActivityBridge().

Typed clients and contracts for the Shiny.AppDeviceBridge GPS and motion activity bridges — GPS readings and listeners, and walking/running/driving recognition — for a web app hosted by Shiny.AppDeviceBridge. Register with services.AddGpsBridgeClient() and AddMotionBridgeClient().
